lines.say: A beer vat burst in London and killed eight people.
A hoop on that vat had slipped off that afternoon. Nobody gave a shit.
Over a hundred thousand gallons of beer hit the slums like a wave.
Eight drowned. Mourners at a toddler's wake, in a basement.
The court called it an act of God. The brewery paid nothing.
God didn't do it. The warning came first, like it always does.
Your clients do it too. Four weeks between cuts, then six, then nine, then it bursts.
